name: Mars air water harvester
subtitle: pulls drinking water from the thin Martian air

effects.effect: sponge-like crystals with a huge inner surface trap one chosen gas

effect: sponge-like crystals with a huge inner surface trap one chosen gas
how: Water is the heaviest thing to ship to Mars, and mining ice means landing only near the poles. A bed of crystal sponges that grab water molecules even at the faint traces in Martian air soaks them up through the frigid night, and sunlight focused by a mirror drives them out by day into a cold trap, with no drilling or digging.
obstacle: Mars air holds so little water that one person's daily supply would need tonnes of sponge and huge airflow.
why: Crystal-sponge harvesters work in Earth deserts; Mars air is far drier.
real: Sorbent-bed extraction of water from Martian air (WAVAR with zeolite, MOFs pitched for Mars) exists only as concepts and technical reports; there is no Mars-condition demonstration.
